name: Knott's Boardwalk BBQ Warm Honey Cornbread Muffin & Creamy Mashed Potatoes / Mac & Cheese Sides
brandOrRestaurant: Boardwalk BBQ (The Boardwalk · Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Even if you only want a small hot side in the afternoon, Boardwalk BBQ sells individual sides of whipped Mashed Potatoes, Cavatappi Mac & Cheese, and soft Cornbread Muffins.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a side of Mashed Potatoes and a Cornbread Muffin for an easy, non-fried mini-meal (take lactase for dairy).
